FlowScape

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Buy Now$10.00 USD or more

In FlowScape you can create your own tiny nature scene simply by painting. 

Choose from 20 landscapes and more than 300 models to create your own private paradise by changing the sky, rotating the sun, adding sound effects and adjust your camera settings for that perfect photo



60 high resolution models of trees, plants flowers, rocks, logs and animals to populate your scenes with

Simple controls, just click and paint


The toolbar has advanced paint options such as align to landscape, size, flow of the brush, random leaning, grow speed, and layers to determine where things get painted



You have 20 unique landscapes as a starting point. From valleys to beaches, rivers and lakes. Yes there is a giant turtle, my daughter (chief play tester) was adamant this was included :)



Create Castles and villages with over 100 different houses

Add Fantasy creatures

Import your own models

Drop objects such as rocks, logs, twigs and leaves into your scene with physics


Put life in your landscape with 12 animals from birds, foxes, horses, stag, deer, butterflies, dragonflies, frogs, trout, rabbits, fireflies and wolves



You can use a combination of 24 4k textures for your landscape and then choose from 12 different skies. In the camera settings there are plenty of sliders to allow you lots of control over your final image

By changing the sky and lighting, you can dramatically alter the mood of your scene

10 different sound ambiances from birds, insects, water and weather



FlowScape is also on Steam. If you prefer to have it on there, that is the place to buy as i don't offer keys with itch purchases.
